name: Probe46RevolveCut
_comment: Issue 46 baseline A: Front-plane 140x90 plate extruded 20 mm (Z[0,20]) + 360 deg revolve boss hub (profile at +Y) + 360 deg revolve cut groove (profile at -Y, opposite-side rule). Seat: FeatureRevolve2(IsCut=True) returned None for CUT_Groove. Geometry arithmetic: groove r[14.0, 15.5] at X[-2, 2] sits inside the hub wall r[12, 16] at X[-6, 6], so this is not an empty-air miss. Args are the handler defaults (flip omitted = ReverseDir False; UseFeatScope/UseAutoSelect pinned True). If this still returns None on a seat, the miss is not 'profile in the wrong place'. Pair with probe_46_revolve_cut_flip.json.
